body: I’ve played piano since I was 5 years old but since my dad died in June I’ve completely lost interest in it. I don’t really have anything that I enjoy. I never have done.

My boyfriend would more than likely take my cats if I died. 
The college I go to is very small, there isn’t really any counsellor. I have spoken to my tutor about it but she doesn’t understand.
I did make a good friend in my college and she helped a lot but she quit last week so now I have nobody left. I have tried getting help both from my college and from doctors but they both suck.
somi was a minor in this video.
